tagline: Full-stack productivity platform with focus tracking, task management, analytics, and secure authentication.

details.overview: FocusFlow is a full-stack productivity platform designed to help users manage tasks, track focus sessions, and improve productivity through analytics. Built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, it combines secure authentication, session tracking, and data-driven insights in a clean and distraction-free experience.
engineering_challenges: Designing PostgreSQL schemas for tasks, focus sessions, and analytics
Implementing secure JWT and Google OAuth authentication
Building productivity analytics from user session data
Creating scalable REST APIs with validation and middleware
key_features: Pomodoro focus timer with session tracking
Task management integrated with focus sessions
Responsive dark and light theme support
what_i_learned: Designing relational databases with Prisma and PostgreSQL
Deploying and maintaining modern web applications
